recent: 99 Speed Mart 公布 2026 财年第三季净利按年增长 16.3% 至 1.898 亿令吉，并宣布派发第二次中期股息每股 2.25 仙。同期，EPF 在 9 月至 11 月期间多次申报其作为大股东的持股变动。

recent_en: 99 Speed Mart reported a 16.3% year-on-year rise in 3Q FY2026 net profit to RM189.8 million and declared a second interim dividend of 2.25 sen per share. Meanwhile, EPF filed multiple substantial shareholder notices regarding its holdings between September and November.
notable_en: 3Q FY2026 net profit rose 16.3% year-on-year to RM189.8 million.
Declared a second interim dividend of 2.25 sen per share for FY2026.
EPF filed multiple substantial shareholder notices between September and November.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM3,075.9 million, up 13.6% year-on-year and 0.2% quarter-on-quarter; net income was RM163.9 million, up 13.4% year-on-year but down 13.1% quarter-on-quarter, with net margin declining to 5.3% from 6.1% in the previous quarter.
